text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen has finally begun.

Seeing a newfound confidence in Mejiro 
Ryan, Mejiro McQueen realized she had 
overcome the weakness in her heart.

Proudly explaining that it was the result 
of training until she was satisfied 
because she couldn't believe in herself, 
Mejiro Ryan—

They headed toward the battle where their 
dreams were at stake.
